slot.brief: find the argument (and quadrant) of a given complex number, possibly after multiplying by a conjugate or simplifying a product

stem: The principal argument of the complex number $\dfrac{(1+i)^2}{1-i\sqrt{3}}$ is

verdicts.working: \((1+i)^2=2i\), with argument \(\pi/2\). The denominator has argument \(-\pi/3\), so the quotient's principal argument is \(\pi/2-(-\pi/3)=5\pi/6\).
